scientific.integrity: The result is an algebraic sharpening of the source threshold formula. Symbolic identities and source-parameter values are replayed by verify.py; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific.limitations: Specific to the homogeneous nonspatial daily map and its Allee recruitment law; R1>1 is a bistable positive-equilibrium regime rather than unconditional persistence.
